dmp.description:
This data management plan was created as part of a doctoral research project dedicated to developing optimized methods for the placement and visualization of three-dimensional objects on a map.
The focus is on the integration of open geospatial data with WebGL-based platforms (specifically CesiumJS), in alignment with the principles of FAIR, reproducibility, and open science.
dmp.title: Optimization of methods for the placement and visualization of 3D objects on a map
